bananaman_43046: In Old Harrow, Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman was a fisherman. In S-F17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a fisherman again.
A flare lit the Ossuary Wood like noon. Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Wendel "Mole" Day kept the tin. Mail came up the line with a letter for Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman. Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Now serving as a chaplain, Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.

The gas alarm sounded during supper. Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman put the bread down carefully and did not finish it until the all-clear. Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars.

A bullet clipped Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman's helmet at S-F17 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy).

A bullet struck Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman below the ribs at S-F17. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy). Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman was killed on watch at S-F17. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy).

The House of Bananaman sent Cyril Bananaman after Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks. The transfer made Cyril Bananaman a machine gunner. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Cyril Bananaman was hit hard in the fight at S-F17 before anyone could fire. The raider was Bram Yma of the Concord. Raider: Bram Yma of the Concord (@yma.tn_). Victory at Blackwater Canal. Cyril Bananaman let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Three days with a bandage, and Cyril Bananaman is back at S-F17. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Cyril Bananaman answered to number 210. On Day 11, Grey Mill passed to the Hegemony. Cyril Bananaman wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Cyril Bananaman was hit through the chest at S-F17. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Norbert Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj). Cyril Bananaman reached the hospital dugout after a long wait. The surgeon took one look at the wound and went to wash up. Cyril Bananaman died in the ward while the orderly was reading him a letter from home. The orderly finished the letter anyway.
Severin "Smokes" Bananaman had heard about Cyril Bananaman's courage. At S-F17, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.

Severin "Smokes" Bananaman felt a hard tug at his hip at S-F17. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Tobias "Brick" Blakeg of the Concord (@blakeg.p11).

A bullet found Severin "Smokes" Bananaman at S-F17, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Emil "Mole" Odin of the Concord (@odin21320). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Severin "Smokes" Bananaman fell at S-F17 and never moved again. Shot by Emil "Mole" Odin of the Concord (@odin21320).
The papers connected Dietrich Bananaman to Severin "Smokes" Bananaman. The men took longer to learn Dietrich Bananaman's own habits, but they made the effort.

Dietrich Bananaman was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Clement Unseen was grazed. Shell splinters peppered S-F17. Dietrich Bananaman picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm.
Dietrich Bananaman sat out the day with a bandaged arm, cleaning every rifle within reach. It was the only job the medic would allow.
Machine-gun fire swept S-F17. Dietrich Bananaman took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Tobias "Brick" Blakeg of the Concord (@blakeg.p11).
Dietrich lay a night and a day on a stretcher in the open trench. Then he stood up, shook out the blanket and went back to S-F17.
charlesdiablo: Quentin Charlesdiabl arrived on Day 9 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Quentin Charlesdiabl watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Quentin Charlesdiabl took stock of his pockets: string, crumbs, a pencil and no sign of the button he was looking for. Grey Mill is lost. Quentin Charlesdiabl heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
Quentin Charlesdiabl and Jonas "Hollow" Argall made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
Quentin Charlesdiabl spent the evening teaching a recruit to sew. The recruit pricked a finger and accused the needle of taking sides.

Quentin Charlesdiabl took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at T-S6, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Valentin Forgacserik of the Hegemony (@forgacserik). Quentin Charlesdiabl looked over the parapet at T-S6 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Valentin Forgacserik of the Hegemony (@forgacserik).
The House of Charlesdiabl sent another. Tobias Charlesdiabl, brother of Quentin Charlesdiabl, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Tobias Charlesdiabl wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Tobias Charlesdiabl used it. Jonas "Whistle" Crawford was badly wounded.
Tobias Charlesdiabl brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load.
Tobias Charlesdiabl remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
Tobias and Jonas "Hollow" Argall carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
diazjr.adrian: Marek Adrian came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Marek Adrian walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir. A letter from home reached Marek Adrian before dusk. Marek Adrian read it twice and slept a little easier. Marek Adrian transferred to the snipers. The men in R-R15 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

Marek Adrian saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at R-R15 and fired once. Karel Sperring was gravely wounded. A letter from home reached Marek Adrian before dusk. Marek Adrian read it twice and slept a little easier. Grey Mill has been won. Marek Adrian listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Marek Adrian watched the enemy lines change the guard at R-R15 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Karel "Button" Nikola was grazed. A letter from home reached Marek Adrian before dusk. Marek Adrian read it twice and slept a little easier.

There is a sniper across the way the men call Grey Hat. Three helmets went up on sticks today. Grey Hat hit all three. Marek Adrian watched where the shots came from. A letter from home reached Marek Adrian before dusk. Marek Adrian read it twice and slept a little easier.

Wiring party. Marek Adrian held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at R-R15, and everyone came back. A letter from home reached Marek Adrian before dusk. Marek Adrian read it twice and slept a little easier.

Marek Adrian lay in the ruins of the Sunken Road all day. Grey Hat did not fire once. Neither did Marek Adrian. Both of them know. A letter from home reached Marek Adrian before dusk. Marek Adrian read it twice and slept a little easier.

At dusk a glint from the ridge. Marek Adrian fired once. The front has been quiet ever since, and nobody talks about Grey Hat any more. A letter for Marek Adrian came with a pressed flower inside. Marek Adrian showed the flower to nobody.

Marek Adrian got a letter from Elias. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Marek Adrian read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third. The transfer made Marek Adrian a stretcher bearer. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

A recruit asked Marek how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. Marek got a letter from the old neighbor, who wrote that Marek's dog now sleeps at the front door every night.
emanvince_: Pavel Emanvince came up on Day 9 carrying news from Millbank. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.
Pavel Emanvince walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Pavel Emanvince and Nils "Mud" Tacomeister share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Pavel Emanvince folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Pavel Emanvince and Silas "Button" Shrex split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

Pavel Emanvince was hit in the forearm at R-R16. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Walter Jameson of the Concord (@jameson.308).
The medics cleaned Pavel Emanvince's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-R16.
Pavel Emanvince studied the trench map until the candle died, then walked R-R16 in the dark to learn it by heart.
Pavel Emanvince censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love.
Blast from a trench mortar threw Pavel Emanvince against the trench wall at R-R16. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.
The stitches came out of Pavel's leg this morning. The medic checked each one twice and said he could go back to R-R16.
emayne2026: The old hands of U-F20 have been here since Day 1. Pavel "Bones" Emayne has been here since Day 11. In a trench, that difference already feels like years. Pavel "Bones" Emayne transferred to the snipers. The men in U-F20 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Pavel "Bones" Emayne helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Pavel "Bones" Emayne had watched a loose sandbag in the enemy wall for two days. This morning it moved. Severin Jromano was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Pavel "Bones" Emayne before the night shift. Pavel "Bones" Emayne folded it small and kept it close.

A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Pavel "Bones" Emayne worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost. A letter from home found Pavel "Bones" Emayne before the night shift. Pavel "Bones" Emayne folded it small and kept it close.

Pavel "Bones" Emayne counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Valentin "Saint" Poysner was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Pavel "Bones" Emayne before the night shift. Pavel "Bones" Emayne folded it small and kept it close.

Pavel "Bones" Emayne waited for someone in the enemy trench to lift a pair of field glasses. Casimir Jromano did, and was grazed. A letter from home found Pavel "Bones" Emayne before the night shift. Pavel "Bones" Emayne folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Pavel "Bones" Emayne's ear at U-F20 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Isidor "Saint" Michael of the Concord (@john.michael2877).

Pavel "Bones" Emayne took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at U-F20, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Albin Rjk of the Concord (@rjk7747). Outside the aid post, Pavel "Bones" Emayne lies on a stretcher among the others. The orderlies step over him and say soon. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Pavel "Bones" Emayne anyway.

Pavel healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving. Pavel read the new letter by the light of a match, then another match, then a third.
enclavecorey05: Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey arrived at T-F14 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached T-F14 with the rations. Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey ate while listening to the revised orders.

Karel "Spark" Freejstax carried Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey's rifle all the way up to Grey Mill after Owl twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A splinter opened Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey's cheek at T-F14. A medic stitched it on the spot and he was back on the fire step before the tea went cold.
Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey and Silas "Button" Shrex exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Albin Edwardss crossed it, Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey fired. Albin Edwardss was badly wounded.

Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey was on the dawn watch at T-F14 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Severin Benson of the Hegemony (@moose_benson).
The medic looked at Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to T-F14. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Dorian taught Bastian Red to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
germandude777: On Day 11 Ulrich "Mole" Germandude took a post at P-F4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He writes everything down in a tiny notebook, and the men liked him for it. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Ulrich "Mole" Germandude helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Ulrich "Mole" Germandude spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Ulrich "Mole" Germandude waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
Ulrich "Mole" Germandude found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores.
Ulrich "Mole" Germandude reached up to fix a sandbag at P-F4 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Clement Alexquinn of the Concord (@alexquinn2802).
Ulrich "Mole" Germandude walked back up the communication trench to P-F4, slower than before, but on his own feet.
The stores supplied Ulrich "Mole" Germandude with shorter boards than requested. The gun shelter has become an exercise in joints and bad language.

Ulrich was hit in the hip at P-F4. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp of the Concord (@speckyjp). A sharpshooter across the wire killed Ulrich at P-F4. The squad covered him with a blanket and wrote down the hour.
Valentin Germandude had heard about Ulrich "Mole" Germandude's courage. At P-F4, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
glass_6321: Nobody asked Silas Glass why he came. Nobody in V-F19 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Silas Glass wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.

Silas Glass threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Tobias Swilikens was down and screaming for a medic. (@swilikens) Silas Glass came back from the night raid on two stretcher poles. Nobody is sure which side fired the shot.
Silas Glass rejoined the squad at V-F19. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Silas. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
jacobmohorcic: They issued Cyril "Ghost" Jacobmohorci a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a rosary of rough beads in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
A note came over the wire at the Bone Quarry, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Hegemony. Signed, Cyril "Ghost" Jacobmohorci.' Ivo Skootybazoom sang louder.
Karel "Saint" Jarosztyler and Cyril "Ghost" Jacobmohorci share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.

Ivo Bmiller had Cyril "Ghost" Jacobmohorci of the Concord in the sights at the Sunken Road for a long second. Cyril "Ghost" Jacobmohorci was lighting a pipe. Ivo Bmiller let the match burn all the way down.
jeanms247: On Day 10, Teodor "Whistle" Jeanms arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

A round went through the rim of Teodor "Whistle" Jeanms's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Severin Lauronendani of the Concord (@lauronendaniel). Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Teodor "Whistle" Jeanms could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

A bullet went into Teodor "Whistle" Jeanms's chest just under the heart at Q-F3. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Otto Wahoocardboa of the Concord (@wahoocardboard). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Teodor "Whistle" Jeanms fell at Q-F3 and never moved again. Shot by Otto Wahoocardboa of the Concord (@wahoocardboard).
The papers say Marek Jeanms. The sergeant says he has his uncle's eyes. Teodor "Whistle" Jeanms's eyes. Nobody in Q-F3 argues.
A supply man offered Marek Jeanms a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.

Marek Jeanms felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F3. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Severin Lauronendani of the Concord (@lauronendaniel).
The medic looked at Marek Jeanms's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to Q-F3. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Marek Jeanms coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a waltz with a scratched introduction, but something knocks once every revolution.
The gramophone stopped knocking after Marek Jeanms tightened a screw. The dugout applauded the repair halfway through a waltz with a scratched introduction, spoiling the best part.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Marek in the open at Q-F3. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Bastian Nekroticdeka of the Concord (@nekroticdekay). A sharpshooter across the wire killed Marek at Q-F3. The squad covered him with a blanket and wrote down the hour.
Another member of the House of Jeanms reached the line: Jonas "Saint" Jeanms. He asked where Marek Jeanms had slept, then chose a different corner.
just._.jawn: The quartermaster asked Matthias Jawn to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

A bullet hit Matthias Jawn's belt buckle at T-F14 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Marek "Lucky" Kid of the Concord (@cappa_kid). Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Matthias Jawn helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Matthias Jawn is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed. Orders assigned Matthias Jawn to work as a field cook. The first lesson began with what not to touch. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Matthias Jawn did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Matthias Jawn went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Jawn. Matthias Jawn read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Matthias Jawn kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
Matthias Jawn obtained a recipe for a batch of potato cakes. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks.
Matthias Jawn raised his head for a heartbeat too long at T-F14. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Zeno "Spark" Dababyislike of the Concord (@dababyislike).

Three days with a bandage, and Matthias Jawn is back at T-F14. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him. The mail bag came up with the soup. There was a letter for Matthias Jawn, and the soup went cold while Matthias Jawn read it.
Matthias Jawn tried a small batch of a batch of potato cakes. The bottom burned before the middle cooked. The tasting committee ate the edges and requested patience.
A bullet clipped Matthias's helmet at T-F14 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Roland Dr of the Concord (@dr8427932).
kevinkukhta: Emil Kevinkukhta joined the replacements on Day 6. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Emil Kevinkukhta passed ration containers down a chain of hands. By the time supper reached the front, every man smelled of it.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Emil Kevinkukhta's bunk. He has named it Duchess.
Emil Kevinkukhta drew the street leading to Old Harrow. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over.

Emil Kevinkukhta joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Emil Kevinkukhta looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A single shot from across the wire hit Emil Kevinkukhta in the thigh at R-S12. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Dietrich Zzz of the Hegemony (@bijan_zzz). Emil Kevinkukhta was killed outright at R-S12, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Dietrich Zzz of the Hegemony (@bijan_zzz).

A letter came with Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta: "I am Emil Kevinkukhta's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. The clerk counted the names twice. Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta is number 453 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta helped stack spare sandbags at R-S12. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.
Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta lent Gustav Skylerb a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Isidor Serrano, was grazed.
Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta of the Concord spotted Cyril Art of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Hill 304. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
A newspaper reached Tobias "Brick" Kevinkukhta with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Tobias carved a notch in the stock for every day on the line. There is not much wood left.
lilmaggs21: Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs arrived on Day 8 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle.
Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs (Hegemony) and Jonas Miked (Concord) ended up in the same shell hole at Verdel Ridge. They stared at each other. Then each crawled home, and neither has told anyone.

Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Rafael "Owl" Franz was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@frankly_franz) Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs landed next to Rafael "Shadow" Gavinlordofp in the Concord trench. Only Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs climbed back out. (@gavinlordofpugs) A bullet struck Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs below the ribs at R-S2. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Nils Man of the Concord (@mister_funni_man). Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs was hit at R-S2 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Nils Man of the Concord (@mister_funni_man).
A letter came with Tobias Lilmaggs: "I am Valentin "Smokes" Lilmaggs's uncle. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Tobias Lilmaggs's ear at R-S2 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Valentin Hect of the Concord (@hect_fr1). Tobias Lilmaggs got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 583. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Lilmaggs watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Tobias Lilmaggs returned to R-S2 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
Tobias Lilmaggs found a photograph in the mud of no man's land: a wedding party, and a name on the back that is not from his side of the wire.
Tobias Lilmaggs keeps the photograph in his pocket next to a tin whistle. He says he will give it back after the war. Nobody asks to whom.
Tobias Lilmaggs has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Bram Briton, badly wounded.
Tobias Lilmaggs carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.
A round went through the rim of Tobias Lilmaggs's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Wendel Princip of the Concord (@gabriello_princip).

Tobias was shot through the shoulder at R-S2. He kept hold of the rifle until the bearers pried it loose. Shot by Gustav "Lucky" Dratlaix of the Concord (@dratlaix). A man in the field hospital died before dawn, and his bed went to Tobias. Nobody pretends that is not how it works.
lutheranapologist: Day 9: Benedikt Lutheranapol reached Q-F5 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Blackwater Canal is lost. Benedikt Lutheranapol heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race. A letter from home reached Benedikt Lutheranapol before dusk. Benedikt Lutheranapol read it twice and slept a little easier.

Benedikt Lutheranapol drew the street leading to Saint-Lune. There was no room left for the last house, so he turned the page over. A letter from home reached Benedikt Lutheranapol before dusk. Benedikt Lutheranapol read it twice and slept a little easier. After the loss of Grey Mill, Benedikt Lutheranapol helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F5. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Benedikt Lutheranapol counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home reached Benedikt Lutheranapol before dusk. Benedikt Lutheranapol read it twice and slept a little easier.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Benedikt Lutheranapol waited for that to change. When it did, Zeno Jimhotrod was grazed.

Benedikt Lutheranapol spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at Q-F5 is closed now. A letter from home reached Benedikt Lutheranapol before dusk. Benedikt Lutheranapol read it twice and slept a little easier.

A bullet went into Benedikt Lutheranapol's chest just under the heart at Q-F5. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Norbert Duran of the Hegemony (@martin.duran67). Benedikt Lutheranapol was killed outright at Q-F5, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Norbert Duran of the Hegemony (@martin.duran67).
The papers connected Emil Lutheranapol to Benedikt Lutheranapol. The men took longer to learn Emil Lutheranapol's own habits, but they made the effort.

The flare went up just as Emil Lutheranapol reached the Hegemony parapet. Emil Lutheranapol jumped down first. Ulrich Ljuliolemosl was the man waiting there, and Ulrich Ljuliolemosl fell. (@ljuliolemosl) Emil Lutheranapol crawled through a gap in the Hegemony wire and slid into their trench. Isidor "Mole" Noamorax reached for a rifle. Emil Lutheranapol was faster with the sharpened shovel. (@noamorax) The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At Q-F5 they left Emil Lutheranapol behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Edmund Combs of the Hegemony (@victor__combs).
Walter Lutheranapol took the same post at Q-F5 where Emil Lutheranapol stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
A bullet grazed Walter Lutheranapol's ribs at Q-F5. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Viktor Kizr of the Hegemony (@ki11z3r6.0).
Walter was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at Q-F5. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Silas Karlczk of the Hegemony (@karlczk1988).
mridz_wan: Bram "Owl" Wan arrived with the Day 8 draft, carrying a rosary of rough beads and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.

Tobias "Brick" Blakeg pulled Bram "Owl" Wan out of a flooded shell hole at Calvary Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Owl" Wan. Bram "Owl" Wan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-S14 with the rations. Bram "Owl" Wan ate while listening to the revised orders. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Owl" Wan. Bram "Owl" Wan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A beetle crawled across Bram "Owl" Wan's sleeve during the long wait. He could do nothing about it without giving away the position. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Owl" Wan. Bram "Owl" Wan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Bram "Owl" Wan answered to number 538. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into S-S14. Bram "Owl" Wan has learned to walk bent double.
Bram "Owl" Wan taught Valentin Henrialexand to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.

Bram "Owl" Wan sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Owl" Wan. Bram "Owl" Wan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bram "Owl" Wan spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at S-S14 is closed now. Bram "Owl" Wan did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Bram "Owl" Wan fired back. Rafael "Tin" Donaldgregor was badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Owl" Wan. Bram "Owl" Wan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A single shot from across the wire hit Bram "Owl" Wan in the thigh at S-S14. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Anselm "Ash" Gossett of the Hegemony (@zach_gossett). Mail came up the line with a letter for Bram "Owl" Wan. Bram "Owl" Wan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Bram "Owl" Wan lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Bram "Owl" Wan read the letter, folded it, unfolded it, and read it again. The sentry pretended not to see.
Bram "Owl" Wan asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
Roland Wan arrived carrying the family name of Bram "Owl" Wan. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

Roland was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-S14. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Oskar Thebaileebla of the Hegemony (@thebaileeblanks). The letter for Roland was mostly about the weather at home. Roland read that part twice too.
mszertao: Day 16. The corporal put Gustav Mszertao beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Gustav Mszertao wrote a song about the Chalk Pits. Jakub "Shadow" Mongus wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
A bullet skipped off a rock and cut Gustav's ear at N-F21. He cursed, wrapped it in a sock, and stayed at the post. Shot by Gustav Godzillasmyb of the Concord (@godzillasmybodyguard).
nicopaoletto: Jonas Nicopaoletto arrived with the Day 6 draft, carrying a rosary of rough beads and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it. Jonas Nicopaoletto walked the captured trenches of Hill 304 and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Jonas Nicopaoletto stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.

On a quiet night Rafael "Owl" Franz (Concord) and Jonas Nicopaoletto (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there. A letter from home found Jonas Nicopaoletto before the night shift. Jonas Nicopaoletto folded it small and kept it close.

Jonas Nicopaoletto found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home found Jonas Nicopaoletto before the night shift. Jonas Nicopaoletto folded it small and kept it close.

Anselm "Saint" Davis of the Concord shouted across the wire at the Chalk Pits, asking for the football scores from home. Jonas Nicopaoletto of the Hegemony shouted them back. Some of them were even true. A letter from home found Jonas Nicopaoletto before the night shift. Jonas Nicopaoletto folded it small and kept it close.

A bullet hit Jonas Nicopaoletto in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-S8. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli of the Concord (@mj_rahimli). A single shot at R-S8. Jonas Nicopaoletto sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Ivo "Ghost" Rahimli of the Concord (@mj_rahimli).

Silas Nicopaoletto had heard about Jonas Nicopaoletto's courage. At R-S8, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. Orders came through: Silas Nicopaoletto is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a rosary of rough beads.

Silas Nicopaoletto tried to remember the price of a loaf in Halden. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. A letter from home found Silas Nicopaoletto before the night shift. Silas Nicopaoletto folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Silas Nicopaoletto is number 372. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill has been won. Silas Nicopaoletto listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Silas Nicopaoletto let the enemy fix the same sandbag three times. The fourth time, Zeno "Lucky" Nugg was grazed.
Silas Nicopaoletto thought about five brothers, all on other fronts on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
Silas Nicopaoletto and Albin Trevor both swear they saw a ghost at Lantern Hill. Each says the other screamed first.

The cook borrowed Silas Nicopaoletto's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory. A letter from home found Silas Nicopaoletto before the night shift. Silas Nicopaoletto folded it small and kept it close.

Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Silas Nicopaoletto waited under a load that got heavier by the minute. A letter came for Silas Nicopaoletto with a ribbon tied around it. Silas Nicopaoletto kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
A letter reached Silas Nicopaoletto from Halden. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Silas went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. The corporal called out the mail. Silas heard the name and almost ran.
rozzyadog: The new machine gunner is Pavel Rozzyadog, once a medical student from Belmonte. The corporal asked if a medical student was any use in a trench. Pavel Rozzyadog said he would find out.
Pavel Rozzyadog and Arno Zhar made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.

Pavel Rozzyadog joined the raid, lay in a shell hole for an hour while the flares burned, and made it home. That counts as a good night out here. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-S3. Pavel Rozzyadog has learned to walk bent double.

Pavel Rozzyadog had just lit a cigarette at R-S3 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Wendel Jesus of the Hegemony (@jesus.gr9). The clerk counted the names twice. Pavel Rozzyadog is number 549 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-S3 with the rations. Pavel Rozzyadog ate while listening to the revised orders.
The medics cleaned Pavel Rozzyadog's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-S3.
Someone asked Pavel Rozzyadog to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Pavel Rozzyadog checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.

A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Pavel Rozzyadog aimed a step ahead and fired: Edmund "Doc" Falloutvam, grazed. A single shot from across the wire hit Pavel Rozzyadog in the thigh at R-S3. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Gustav Marksebastio of the Hegemony (@marksebastion).
Pavel Rozzyadog lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
Pavel Rozzyadog never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
A shot from across the wire took the top off Pavel's mess tin at R-S3. His wrist stung for an hour. Dinner was ruined. Shot by Hugo Marcusho of the Hegemony (@marcusho64).
spring_7398: "You're late," said the corporal when Yann Spring arrived on Day 3. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Yann Spring helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The dugout roof dripped into Yann Spring's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii and Yann Spring carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.

Yann Spring fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Ivo "Bones" Rylan, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Yann Spring watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Albin "Tin" Shoes and Yann Spring tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Yann Spring traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
Yann Spring fired at a loophole in the enemy wall and heard a shout. It was Matthias "Rabbit" Forn, grazed.
A round went through Yann Spring's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Benedikt Shi of the Hegemony (@rei0_shi4).

Yann Spring's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F6 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Yann Spring watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Yann Spring's ear at R-F6 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Otto Tyner of the Hegemony (@tyner_1776). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Yann Spring is number 172. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Yann Spring wrote to a dog called Bastion on the farm that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Back on the fire step at R-F6. Yann Spring says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign.

Yann Spring fixed the bayonet, then thought better of it and fired instead. Across the wire, Bastian "Owl" Branden was badly wounded. Yann Spring was hit in the thigh crossing the Drowned Farm. He crawled the last yards back to the trench on his elbows.
A medic brought Yann Spring half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
Yann Spring did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
The House of Spring sent Viktor Spring after Yann Spring. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.

Viktor Spring was hit through the stomach at R-F6. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Dietrich Soccer of the Hegemony (@canaan.a.soccer). Clean sheets, a lamp, and a surgeon. Viktor Spring was admitted to the hospital dugout and finally let go of his rifle. The bleeding has stopped. Viktor Spring asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen.
No bed for Viktor Spring yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up.
Viktor left the aid post this morning with a limp and a sack of bandages. He reached R-F6 by noon.
yandaue: Jonas Yandaue walked into N-F8 on Day 14 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Jonas Yandaue sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Jonas Yandaue tried to write home with gloves on. The address is readable. Everything else will need some imagination.

Jonas Yandaue was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at N-F8. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Rafael "Saint" Sureshot of the Concord (@sureshot1021). The bearers reached Jonas Yandaue at N-F8 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Rafael "Saint" Sureshot of the Concord (@sureshot1021).
Arno "Bones" Yandaue arrived carrying the family name of Jonas Yandaue. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Arno checked the fire step after the shelling. The wall had moved, and the spot where he always put his foot was gone.
